_source: POST /api/v1/projects/engagement-portal/deploy when the project read fails for a reason that is not absence: TriggerDeploy answers 404 "project not found: "+err.Error() for ANY error of K8s.GetProject (handlers/projects.go:2953-2957), which is a live Get of the namespace tenant-<name> wrapped as "project not found: %w" (clients/kubernetes.go:1528-1533), hence the doubled prefix. The Get's text is a stand-in API-server timeout (review t04 M2)
